sentences.text: For this UCB, the in-force directions say no upper limit or cap for penal charges has been prescribed, so the documents do not support a 2% cap.

The same in-force directions say penal charges must be treated as penal charges and not as penal interest, and additional or fresh penal charges shall not be levied on the earlier outstanding amount of penal charges.
The bank’s own documents state penal charges of ₹500 per month of default, but they do not state any percentage cap.

missing.slot: maximum penal charge amount or rate under a 2% cap
missing.searched: Checked the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions and the bank’s own loan documents; no 2% cap was found, and the in-force rule says no upper limit/cap has been prescribed.
